implemented_route: apps/cli -> Core::run -> input::mathematics_intent -> Intent::FiniteEventProbability -> math::finite_event_probability -> normalize_weight_values
supported_behavior_from_source: Japanese 「事象確率 [outcomes] 重み [weights] 事象値 [values] を計算して」 / 「を計算してください」 and English `event-probability [outcomes] weights [weights] values [values]` parse three explicit flat exact-scalar arrays.

Outcomes and weights must each contain 1..4096 elements and have equal lengths. Event values may be empty and contain at most 4096 entries. Negative outcomes are allowed; weights must be nonnegative with a positive total.

Each exact outcome is compared with the exact event-value set. Duplicate event values do not double-count; repeated outcomes at different positions contribute each position’s own normalized probability mass.

Core returns normalized probabilities, exact probability sum, aligned event-membership flags and aligned per-outcome probability contributions. It sums contributions exactly; an empty event set returns zero.

The result is scoped to the explicitly supplied finite outcome list and event values; it is not an empirical or real-world estimate. Numeric representation and operation budgets remain bounded; trailing constraints are rejected.
